Overview

About the RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

The NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition is a universal data center GPU that combines Blackwell AI performance with professional graphics, ray tracing and video. Its 96 GB of GDDR7 memory handles large models, 3D scenes and datasets.

It is the GPU behind NVIDIA RTX PRO Servers, an enterprise AI factory platform that runs agentic AI, physical AI, simulation, rendering and virtual workstations on standard air-cooled servers.

Fifth-generation Tensor Cores

Up to 3x the performance of the previous generation with FP4 precision and DLSS 4.

Fourth-generation RT Cores

Up to 2x faster ray tracing, with RTX Mega Geometry for up to 100x more triangles.

96 GB GDDR7

1,597 GB/s of bandwidth for massive 3D projects and AI datasets.

Media engines

Ninth-generation NVENC adds 4:2:2 H.264/HEVC; sixth-generation NVDEC doubles H.264 decode throughput.

Multi-Instance GPU

Split one GPU into up to four fully isolated instances with guaranteed quality of service.

DisplayPort 2.1

Drives up to 8K at 240 Hz or 16K at 60 Hz.
